item.title: Self-Hosted Process Monitoring Exporters: process-exporter vs Node Problem Detector vs Telegraf (2026)
item.description: System monitoring at the host level requires more than CPU and memory metrics — you need visibility into individual processes. Which applications are consuming the most resources? Are critical services running? Have any processes entered problematic states? Process monitoring exporters answer these questions by exposing per-process metrics to your observability stack.
